title: Python Decorators
summary: A decorator is a function that wraps another function to add behavior to it without changing its code.
common_mistakes: Forgetting to return the wrapper function
Forgetting to pass *args and **kwargs to the original function
Losing the original function name and docstring by not using functools.wraps
practice_idea: Create a decorator that logs the name of a function each time it is called.

title: List Comprehensions
summary: A short way to build a new list from an existing iterable, with an optional filter, in a single line.
key_concepts: Expression and loop in one line
common_mistakes: Writing comprehensions that are too long to read
Putting the if and else in the wrong place
Using a comprehension just for side effects, like printing
practice_idea: Given a list of numbers, create a new list with the squares of only the even numbers.

title: Exception Handling
summary: A way to deal with errors during execution so the program can react instead of crashing.
common_mistakes: Using a bare except that hides every error
Catching an exception and doing nothing with it
Putting too much code inside the try block
practice_idea: Write a function that asks the user for a number and keeps asking until the input is valid.

title: Recursion
summary: A technique where a function calls itself to solve a smaller version of the same problem.
common_mistakes: Forgetting the base case, which causes infinite recursion
Not making the problem smaller at each call
Recomputing the same values many times, like in a naive Fibonacci
practice_idea: Write a recursive function that computes the factorial of a number, then do the same with a loop.

title: Python Dictionaries
summary: A data structure that stores values by key, so you can find a value quickly from its name.
common_mistakes: Getting a KeyError by accessing a key that does not exist
Using a list as a key, which is not allowed
Modifying a dictionary while looping over it
practice_idea: Count how many times each word appears in a sentence and store the result in a dictionary.
